latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Billions decentralized identity skill for agents.
- Enables agents to create and manage decentralized identities and link them to human owners using the Billions Network.
- Provides scripts for creating identities, generating and signing challenges, linking human and agent identities, and verifying ownership.
- Strict guardrails enforced for secure identity management—only supported scripts may be used, with no manual cryptographic workarounds allowed.
- Identity and key data are stored under $HOME/.openclaw/billions for plugin compatibility and security.
